title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating + metrics integration
author: Priya Kaur
description: Add CI gating for prompt-set regressions and integrate eval metrics into pipeline. Motivation: to catch quality regressions caused by model swaps/quantization changes early in CI; provide observable metrics per-prompt set and fail builds when metrics drop beyond configured thresholds. Changes: 1) new GH Action job `eval-harness/regressions` that runs eval-harness against configured prompt sets (smoke, semantic-quality, safety) on a lightweight reference model; 2) adds `eval_metrics` uploader step that posts summary to internal metrics service and to the PR comment; 3) configurable gating YAML `ci/eval-gates.yaml` with thresholds and per-path allowlists; 4) small refactor to `eval-harness/runner.py` to return stable JSON summary for CI consumption; 5) tests and fixtures. Checklist: - [x] Implement GH Action job - [x] Implement gating config parser - [x] Implement metrics uploader - [x] Add unit tests - [x] Add docs in eval-harness/README.md - [x] Add Linear links (ENG-1402, ENG-1410). Risk/Notes: Gate runs on a reference small model in CI to bound cost; thresholds are intentionally conservative and can be tightened after a rollout. This PR includes a temporary feature flag `EVAL_CI_GATES=1` guarded in the workflow for gradual enablement. Related: PR #998765 (previous metrics integration), ENG-1100 (alerting for quality regressions).

Priya Kaur: Added matrix with `mode: [short, full]` and default CI runs `short` on PRs and `full` on scheduled/nightly.
Diego Morales: Approved after nits fixed. (approved)

release_notes: Introduces CI gating for eval-harness prompt regressions, per-prompt-set thresholds, and metrics integration to post results to PRs and internal metrics service. Default runs are conservative and enabled behind feature flag.
